label: Coupang
terms_note: Wing vendor account certified as a business operator (general members cannot get keys); keys issued instantly in Wing (rights may take >24 h), valid 180 days with reissue 14 days before expiry; up to 10 allow-listed caller IPs — our egress must be static; no fee for the API; no rate limit published; no sandbox — tests run against production with Postman.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the
auth: 1. Register as a vendor on wing.coupang.com and complete business-operator certification.

2. Wing › account menu › Seller Information / Additional Sales Information › issue Open API key; enter up to 10 caller IPs (or wing.coupang.com as URL if no homepage) → Access Key + Secret Key (+ vendorId).

3. Sign every request: message = signed-date (yyMMddTHHmmssZ) + method + path + URL-encoded query; `Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=…, signed-date=…, signature=…`; also `X-Requested-By: <vendorId>`.
4. Keys expire after 180 days (reissue button 14 days before; e-mails 2 and 1 weeks ahead).

endpoints.notes: category, items (vendor items), images, attributes, delivery + return policy

endpoints.call: Promotions / coupons (21 endpoints), categories, brands, logistics, customer service, CGF / Rocket Growth

reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened (developer centre lists none). - Business-certified Wing vendor only; keys are the seller's own (no third-party app model). - Caller IPs must be allow-listed (max 10). - Markets: Korea and Taiwan.

fields.name: access_key
fields.help: Coupang Open API Access Key issued in WING (판매자정보 > 추가판매정보 > OPEN API 키 발급) after business verification; calls must come from one of the (up to 10) allow-listed IPs, and keys expire and must be re-issued.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The matching Secret Key: signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over signed-date + method + path + query, sent as `Authorization: CEA algorithm=HmacSHA256, access-key=..., signed-date=..., signature=...`). Never sent on the wire.

config_fields.name: vendor_id
config_fields.help: Coupang vendorId (업체코드, e.g. A00012345), shown in WING after login; used by the probe.

adapter.terms: Coupang Open API keys are issued in WING (판매자정보 > 추가판매정보 > OPEN API 키 발급); calls must come from one of up to 10 allow-listed IPs and keys expire (re-issue in WING). Item-level writes address the option id (vendorItemId, 옵션ID) that Coupang assigns once a product is approved.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists one registered product ({code, message, nextToken, data[]}) to verify the HMAC keys, IP allow-list and vendorId.

update_listing.note: UPDATE_PRODUCT_PRICE_BY_ITEM: PUT /vendor-items/{vendorItemId}/prices/{price}?forceSalePriceUpdate=true changes the SALE PRICE of one option (listing_id = vendorItemId, 옵션ID) — the price goes live on coupang.com. Only `price` is applied (KRW in Korea, whole number in steps of 10 won); forceSalePriceUpdate=true lifts the default -50%/+100% change guard, so double-check the amount. Use set_inventory for stock; title and description are product-level (modify-product) and are not changed here.

set_inventory.note: UPDATE_PRODUCT_QUANTITY_BY_ITEM: PUT /vendor-items/{vendorItemId}/quantities/{quantity} sets the stock of one option; `listing_id` is the vendorItemId (옵션ID) and is required (Coupang items are not addressed by SKU).

end_listing.note: STOP_PRODUCT_SALES_BY_ITEM: PUT /vendor-items/{vendorItemId}/sales/stop suspends sales of one option (reversible with /sales/resume); the product itself is not deleted.

not_offered.create_listing: Product creation (POST /v2/providers/seller_api/apis/api/v1/marketplace/seller-products, https://developers.coupang.com/ko/api/products/product-creation) needs displayCategoryCode, brand, delivery/return settings (outbound shipping place code, return center), required category notices and attributes per item; the vocabulary carries none of them, and new products go through Coupang approval.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /v2/providers/openapi/apis/api/v5/vendors/{vendorId}/ordersheets requires createdAtFrom AND createdAtTo ("yyyy-mm-dd+09:00", at most 31 days apart) and a single status (https://developers.coupang.com/ko/api/shipments/po-list-query-paging-by-day); the vocabulary has only `since` and no way to derive the required end date.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Invoice upload (POST /v2/providers/openapi/apis/api/v4/vendors/{vendorId}/orders/invoices) requires per line shipmentBoxId, vendorItemId, deliveryCompanyCode, splitShipping and preSplitShipped besides orderId and invoiceNumber (https://developers.coupang.com/ko/api/shipments/uploading-waybills); shipmentBoxId and vendorItemId are not vocabulary inputs.

live_check.notes: requires access_key, secret_key, vendor_id; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
